headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.57
summary: Outgoing Xbox friend requests can now be listed and canceled, friend profiles open correctly, Minecraft-style content metadata renders its colors, and the theme picker keeps only Dark AMOLED.

items.text: Show sent friend requests in the Requests tab and allow canceling them.
Refresh the dashboard Xbox friends card when the active account changes or the app starts.
Refresh friends and request lists automatically after accept, decline, cancel, and remove actions.
Open Xbox friend profiles through the account.xbox.com profile page.
Apply the selected theme color to Xbox friends tabs, buttons, and dialogs.
Render Minecraft section-sign color codes in pack and mod names and descriptions.
